events.name: Jurassic Quest – Savannah, GA | Savannah Convention Center
events.description:
The Ultimate Family Adventure Is Here!
Jurassic Quest is bigger than ever, bringing together dinosaurs, prehistoric sea creatures, and Ice Age giants in one unforgettable experience.
🦕 Jurassic Quest – Walk among life-sized, moving dinosaurs including the mighty T. rex, towering Apatosaurus, and massive Spinosaurus. Dig for fossils, meet adorable baby dinos, and ride your favorite prehistoric giants.
🌊 Ancient Oceans – Dive beneath the surface and come face-to-face with incredible creatures that ruled the seas millions of years ago, including our jaw-dropping 53-foot Megalodon.
❄️ Frozen Frontier – Step into the Ice Age and encounter legendary creatures like the Woolly Mammoth and Saber-Toothed Cat as you explore a world frozen in time.
Plus enjoy interactive exhibits, hands-on activities, inflatables, rides, photo opportunities, and prehistoric fun for the whole family.
🎟️ One ticket gets you access to all three incredible experiences. Don't miss North America's largest prehistoric adventure — get your tickets before they go extinct! 🦖✨

events.name: A Magical Cirque Christmas (Touring)
events.info: For more than five spectacular holiday seasons, A Magical Cirque Christmas has captivated fans and welcomed families, making it part of their seasonal celebrations. Overflowing with festive charm and dazzling cirque artistry, A Magical Cirque Christmas showcases the extraordinary talents of world-class performers through gravity-defying acrobatics, awe-inspiring displays of strength and agility, laugh-out-loud comedy, and heartwarming magic. Set to a lively soundtrack of modern holiday hits, each act delivers a fresh and unforgettable Christmastime experience. Beloved by audiences of all ages, A Magical Cirque Christmas is a joyful way to celebrate the season together.

events.name: Savannah Hoops Shootout
Savannah Hoops Shootout
South Carolina Ballet's Nutcracker
events.info: William Starrett's Nutcracker, South Carolina's most loved holiday tradition. This sumptuous production brings Tchaikovsky's magnificent score, exquisite dancing, and the wonder of the season to the stage in a celebration that has become a cherished part of Christmas for families across South Carolina. A full-length production of exceptional scale and beauty, William Starrett's Nutcracker features grand scenery, beautiful costumes, and the artistry of South Carolina Ballet's professional dancers in a holiday classic filled with enchantment, warmth, and theatrical splendor. Audiences of all ages will be swept away by its memorable characters, magical moments, and the unmistakable charm that has made this production a favorite for generations. Discover precisely why it simply is not Christmas until you see South Carolina Ballet's Nutcracker.
